name: MKT_SEM_ADGROUP_RESULTS
description: This table will be used to store SEM Ad group Results.Total impressions, click and such other data about individual Search Engine Marketing ad groups.

columns.name: CONNECTIONID
columns.description: Connection ID. This is the connection ID under which the adgroup is created.

columns.name: ADGROUP_ID
columns.description: Ad Group ID (as generated on Fusion side)

columns.name: VENDOR_ADGROUP_ID
columns.description: Vendor's Ad group ID as assigned on the vendor side.

columns.name: ADGROUP
columns.description: the name/description associated with an ad group.

columns.name: CAMPAIGN_ID
columns.description: Campaign ID that is associated with this ad group

columns.name: REPORTDATE
columns.description: Report Date. this is the date against which the activity of a given ad group will be noted.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of the ad group as provided by SEM vendor.

columns.name: IMPRESSIONS
columns.description: Impressions  for a given ad group on a given day.

columns.name: CLICKS
columns.description: Clicks for a given ad group on a given day.

columns.name: CTR
columns.description: Click Thru Rate  for a given ad group on a given day.

columns.name: AVGCPC
columns.description: Average Cost per click  for a given ad group on a given day.

columns.name: COST
columns.description: Cost  for a given ad group on a given day.

columns.name: AVGPOSITION
columns.description: 'Average position' is a statistic attributed to each of your adgroups. It refers to the average position on a search result page that an ad appears in when it's triggered by that ad group.

columns.name: CURRENCY
columns.description: Currency associated with a given ad group

columns.name: AVGCPM
columns.description: It's your average cost of 1000 impressions for your ad group or search keyword.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
